description: Sixteen newly authored synthetic coding mechanisms, split by incident. Two implicit questions plus literal/file controls per incident; all corpus facts equally verified. Explicitly justified no-match requests remain assistant-authored judgments. Freeze before encoder scoring.

corpus.title: journal-durability
corpus.content: Flush the write-ahead journal to durable storage before acknowledging a committed transaction.

corpus.title: lease-fencing
corpus.content: Attach a monotonically increasing fencing token to writes; the storage service rejects tokens older than the last accepted owner.

corpus.title: stream-reservoir
corpus.content: Use reservoir sampling to retain a uniform random sample from an unbounded stream with fixed memory.

corpus.title: merkle-reconciliation
corpus.content: Compare Merkle subtree hashes and descend only into differing subtrees when reconciling replicas.

corpus.title: dns-negative-cache
corpus.content: Cache authoritative NXDOMAIN answers only for their negative TTL, then query the authority again.

corpus.title: observed-remove-set
corpus.content: Give each set insertion a unique tag; removal deletes only the insertion tags observed by that replica.

corpus.title: sql-parameter-binding

corpus.title: constant-time-mac
corpus.content: Compare authentication tags with a constant-time primitive rather than returning at the first differing byte.

corpus.title: online-variance
corpus.content: Update the running mean and squared deviations with Welford’s recurrence to avoid cancellation in streaming variance.

corpus.title: download-filename-encoding
corpus.content: Send non-ASCII download names with the UTF-8 filename* parameter in Content-Disposition and a plain fallback filename.

corpus.title: cors-preflight
corpus.content: Answer an OPTIONS preflight with the explicitly allowed origin, methods and request headers before the browser sends the cross-origin call.

corpus.title: image-orientation
corpus.content: Apply the EXIF orientation transform once during image decoding and clear the orientation metadata on the normalized output.

corpus.title: shortest-path-queue
corpus.content: When popping a shortest-path queue entry, skip it if its distance no longer equals the node’s best recorded distance.

corpus.title: bisect-unbuildable

corpus.title: binary-checksum
corpus.content: Compute the checksum over the original byte sequence before text decoding or newline normalization.
